card: Adds unit test coverage for CheckTransaction when a transaction contains a negative output value following a positive output value. Existing unit tests allowed a mutation altering the individual output non-negativity check to pass undetected. The author notes this mutation could otherwise permit invalid outputs through CheckTransaction without detection until later in GetValueOut.
evidence: PR description: 'Kills mutant https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4675... This mutant could lead to an inflation bug, and the only other check that prevents that is in GetValueOut.'
problem: Test coverage for CheckTransaction did not exercise a negative output appearing after a positive output value, allowing mutations that check running totals rather than individual outputs to pass tests undetected.

risk.why: Only touches unit test code and cannot affect production consensus validation.

scope_notes: Small test addition (+12 lines). The patch itself was omitted from the PR record.
summary: Adds unit test coverage to ensure CheckTransaction rejects transactions containing a negative output value placed after a positive output value. This targets a specific surviving mutant where the individual output non-negativity check was altered into a cumulative sum check.
